slides.body: Three findings shape my operating perspective. Each requires a different work product.

items: INC won 64 state seats in 2023 but none in my declared 15-seat study set.
I would keep institution-specific election briefs and challenge citywide extrapolation.
The 2026 three-corporation structure changes the administrative unit.
I would version the geography crosswalk before joining service or election data.
Budget provision is a starting point for implementation scrutiny.
I would track release, delivery and service experience separately.
